settings.note: Binary model with drop-groups first, direct feature correction for W2 health, then split specified W2 predictor groups into configured subscales. Current main-paper planning uses W2 predictors only for W2->W2 and W2->W3 tasks.

subscale_config.purpose: Current subscale definitions for Feature_Decomposition. Main analyses use W2 predictors only for W2->W2 and W2->W3. W2 v54_18 is assigned to Responsible Decision-Making, not Self-Awareness.
subscale_config.scoring_note: Each decomposed subscale is scored as the row-wise mean of available included items; rows with all included items missing become missing. Current main-paper analyses use W2 predictors for W2->W2 and W2->W3. W3 definitions are retained as reference mapping only.

v52_health.note: W2 self-rated health is stored as scalar item v52. It is different from the retained W2 self-worth item set v52_1 to v52_3.
